phase_0.boundary_condition: the hardened steel housing of the regulator assembly
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.justification: the drive shaft increases in velocity toward the slip threshold

AREV.justification: the internal resistance acting against the primary drive direction to maintain regulation

CLINK.justification: the mechanical coupling of the input shaft to the internal regulator plates

ENGAGR.justification: the microscopic state where the plates are simultaneously gripping and sliding

EVALF.justification: the activation of the friction plates to prevent over-torque failure

EVALT.justification: the successful transmission of torque within the specified safety parameters

FFUSE.justification: the recombination of work and heat to account for the total input energy

FSPLIT.justification: the critical point where the input force divides into transmitted torque and dissipated slip

IFIX.justification: the permanent material wear and microscopic deformation on the friction discs

IMSCRIB.justification: the state where the mechanism maintains its current velocity without external change

TANCH.justification: the final state where kinetic energy has fully transitioned into ambient heat within the housing

VINIT.justification: the system exists in a state of zero velocity before the application of rotational force

phase_3.both_description: the boundary layer of the friction fluid during phase transition
phase_3.false_description: active slip to prevent mechanical shearing

steps.domain_action: torque increases as the motor ramps to speed
system reaches the first stability plateau
load remains below the shear limit
power transmits to the output assembly
load exceeds the regulator set point
friction plates slide to shed excess force
plates oscillate between static and kinetic friction
heat creates permanent carbonization on the disc surface
energy balance accounts for work and heat
regulator locks as the drive cycle terminates

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the spring-loaded tensioner setting the slip pressure
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the hydraulic fluid pressure between the regulator plates
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the cumulative wear depth on the friction discs
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the centrifugal governor determining the engagement timing

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the system converts high-grade mechanical energy into low-grade heat while preserving the total energy sum
phase_6.post_cycle_state: kinetic work performed plus waste heat
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: potential energy stored in the drive motor
